components.name: Structural N Monogram
components.description: The SuperNova identity mark, drawn as a structural N with two construction-square accents.
components.html: <svg class="ds-monogram" viewBox="0 0 180 180" role="img" aria-label="SuperNova Engenharia"><rect x="12" y="12" width="156" height="156" rx="18"/><path d="M49 132V48h21l40 55V48h21v84h-21L70 77v55H49Z"/><path class="ds-coral" d="M114 45h21v21h-21z"/><path class="ds-mint" d="M45 114h21v21H45z"/></svg>

narrative.overview: SuperNova presents engineering as the threshold between a stalled property decision and a viable next move. The landing page pairs a late-afternoon local architecture image with dark glazing, concrete, and brise-soleil material cues; a dark-green overlay turns that photograph into a calm, legible field for the opening claim. The supporting system is editorial and structural. Large Brygada 1918 statements, precise DM Mono facts, hairline dividers, and a compact structural N monogram give residential and commercial work a considered, technical character. Pale paper, light mint, and one coral proof panel break the dark field into clear reading stages.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-green architectural image field at the first viewport.
Structural N monogram with coral and mint construction-square accents.
Editorial serif decisions paired with direct sans-serif service copy and mono metadata.
Full-width material shifts, numbered service records, and thin structural rules.

rules.name: The Architectural Field Rule
rules.body: The first viewport layers text on the rendered image at `dist/assets/hero-architecture-v2.png` through a dark-green gradient; preserve enough overlay contrast for the image to remain atmospheric and the copy to remain legible.

rules.name: The Single Proof Rule
rules.body: Coral is a marker, focus treatment, or one full proof panel, never a general-purpose page ground.

rules.name: The Decision-and-Detail Rule
rules.body: Set the key decision in Brygada 1918, the explanation in DM Sans, and only compact facts in DM Mono.

rules.name: The Structural Reading Rule
rules.body: Grids, rules, indexes, and the hero overlay must clarify the sequence from problem to technical service to contact.

rules.name: The Material Plane Rule
rules.body: Use image, color fields, and borders to separate planes; reserve shadow for copy legibility on the hero image rather than surface elevation.

dos: Do use the late-afternoon local architecture image as the hero's material evidence, with the implemented green overlay treatment.
Do pair large Brygada decision language with direct DM Sans service copy and DM Mono technical facts.
Do keep services as indexed records with hairlines and a single circular arrow action.
Do retain the structural N monogram and its two construction-square accents as the identity mark.
Do use a visible coral focus outline for keyboard interaction.
donts: Don't add generic cards or their shadows; use structural rules and field changes for grouping.
Don't turn coral into a broad repeated surface treatment outside its implemented proof, marker, and interaction roles.
Don't use DM Mono for paragraphs or make labels compete with decision headlines.
Don't round fields, proof panels, or service records; reserve rounded forms for controls, markers, and the monogram tile.
